decided: A program counts as signed whenever the user's latest signature covers exactly the text of the latest saved brief, even a signature recorded by hand before the program's closing review; the specs now say so as a known limit.
alternatives: count a signature only when it was given after the closing review, so a signature recorded by hand before that review asks the user again
why: The user chose it: the signature proves they read exactly this text, and the architect session itself asks only after the closing review, so only a signature recorded by hand reaches this case.
